abstract: How does senescent cell heterogeneity vary across different cell types in the liver in aging, fibrosis, and cancer? In Cell Genomics, Karpova and Li et al. reveal cell-type- and context-specific senescent cell signatures, offering the community a valuable resource and providing the potential for future therapeutic innovation.
